title: T-Rex Dino
description: Run and jump over obstacles in this endless runner game.
about:
T-Rex Dino is a browser game where you jump over approaching obstacles and survive for as long as possible.

Start a round in your browser and use the controls below to play.
howToPlay: Jump over approaching obstacles and survive for as long as possible.
tips: Use space / up arrow / tap to jump.
Try another round to practice the timing and strategy.

faq.question: How do I play T-Rex Dino?
faq.answer: Jump over approaching obstacles and survive for as long as possible.

faq.question: Can I play T-Rex Dino in a browser?
faq.answer: Yes. Open the game page and play without installing an app.
